connector.name: Docling MCP
connector.registryDescription: Convert PDFs and other documents to structured formats via Docling, for AI applications.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package docling-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the docling-project account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Docling Serve instance. Required when conversion mode is remote.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticating with Docling Serve.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_TIMEOUT
env.description: Request timeout in seconds for the remote Docling Serve API. Default: 300.0.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for remote API requests. Default: 3.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_FALLBACK_TO_LOCAL
env.description: Set to 'true' to fall back to local conversion when Docling Serve is unreachable.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_KEEP_IMAGES
env.description: Set to 'true' to retain page images in converted documents. Default: false.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_IMAGES_SCALE
env.description: Image scale factor (e.g. 1.0, 2.0). Increase to avoid tensor batching errors. Default: 1.0.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_OCR
env.description: Set to 'false' to disable the OCR pipeline. Default: true.

env.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_TABLE_STRUCTURE
env.description: Set to 'false' to disable table structure detection. Default: true.
